fonts.display: 'roobert', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'roobert', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Lime Volt
palette.role: Primary action — filled CTA buttons, active tab underline, highlight chips. The only vivid color permitted against the dark hero; its near-fluorescent chroma against #051923 creates urgency without warmth or aggression

palette.name: Cobalt Iris
palette.role: Violet outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges

palette.name: Midnight Abyss
palette.role: Primary text, hero background, dark section canvas, button text on lime fills. Near-black with a cool teal undertone — not pure black, the slight blue cast keeps it feeling engineered rather than flat

palette.name: Abyssal Teal
palette.role: Dark card surfaces and gradient endpoints — the bridge color between Midnight Abyss and the deep teal radial gradient. Used for elevated dark cards and inset panels

palette.name: Steel Mist
palette.role: Light neutral action fill for buttons on dark surfaces.

palette.name: Charcoal Edge
palette.role: Muted body text and secondary borders. Zinc-family dark gray for hierarchy below the primary text level

palette.name: Zinc
palette.role: Icon strokes, tertiary text, disabled states, and subtle dividers. The lightest chrome in the interface

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Secondary body text, caption labels, metadata. Mid-gray for body content that must read but recede

palette.name: Pure White
palette.role: Card surfaces, button text, and form inputs — the brightest point in the surface stack. Cards on the Steel Mist canvas read as crisp white panels
